title: crataegus polita var. tatnalliana
intro: Crataegus polita var. tatnalliana, commonly known as Tatnall's hawthorn, is a variety of Crataegus polita, a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the southeastern United States. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, improving cardiovascular health, and reducing the risk of heart disease. The therapeutic actions of Tatnall's hawthorn include acting as a vasodilator, improving circulation, and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, such as quercetin and rutin, as well as organic acids like malic acid and citric acid.
